_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in MYR. The debt component and history are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_malaysia.py from the official source named below; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Malaysia
publisher: Bank Negara Malaysia (via the national open-data portal, data.gov.my)
title: Malaysia Debt Clock: Live Federal Government Debt, Official Data
headline: federal government debt
subject: The Government of Malaysia
sum_note: Malaysia's outstanding federal government debt (domestic and external), quarter-end, from Bank Negara Malaysia's quarterly series on the national open-data portal (federal government debt by remaining maturity). Gross.
scope_note: This is the quarterly series of federal government debt on data.gov.my, compiled by Bank Negara Malaysia from federal government debt records and presented by remaining maturity (not by instrument): government securities (MGS, MGII, treasury bills and others) and loans, domestic plus external, in ringgit at each quarter-end. It is the gross debt of the federal government. It does not include the debt guaranteed by the government, the liabilities under public-private financing arrangements, or the debt of state governments and statutory bodies. Domestic and external parts add up to the total.
trend_why: We use the change over the latest twelve months rather than the latest period alone, because changes between single reporting dates swing with the issuance calendar and short-term borrowing.
legend: Malaysia's federal government debt is reported at period-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Quarterly. Bank Negara Malaysia adds each quarter-end position to the open-data portal some weeks after the quarter ends.
next_update: Bank Negara Malaysia adds each quarter-end position to the open-data portal some weeks after the quarter ends; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: World Bank, World Development Indicators, Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), Malaysia, 2025 (UN Population Division and national statistical offices)
population.method_short: World Bank 2025 population estimate, all ages

components.label: Malaysia federal government debt
components.source_name: Bank Negara Malaysia, Quarterly federal government debt by remaining maturity, data.gov.my, RM million
components.source_locator: Dataset federal_finance_qtr_debt_mat, rows type=total, maturity=total, sector=total (also domestic, external); each row is dated the first day of the quarter, the position is the quarter-end
components.includes: Federal government debt, gross: domestic securities and loans plus external debt, in ringgit. Government-guaranteed debt, PFI commitments and state and statutory-body debt are not included.

extra_sources.name: Ministry of Finance Malaysia, Fiscal outlook and federal government revenue estimates

notes: Why the open-data series: it is Bank Negara Malaysia's quarterly compilation of federal government debt records, machine-readable, and the fetcher checks that the domestic and external parts add up to the total.
Federal government only: Malaysia also has government-guaranteed debt and other commitments, which the Ministry reports separately and which are not added here.
Currency: Malaysian ringgit. The World Debt Clock converts at the ECB's daily reference rate for the ringgit.
